summary: Off-registry unpinned git dependency resolves to mutable HEAD at install time
details: package.json declares the `libsignal` dependency as a bare git URL (`git+https://github.com/whiskeysockets/libsignal-node`) with no commit SHA or tag pin. On `npm install`, npm clones whatever the default branch of that GitHub repository currently points to and runs any lifecycle scripts inside the fetched tree on the installer's machine, with no version constraint, no integrity check, and no reproducibility across installs. Whoever controls the referenced GitHub repository (or takes it over) can substitute arbitrary code into every downstream installer's dependency tree without publishing anything to npm.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
